name: Dirt Street
description:
Until recently, this was an undeveloped field, intended for use by
the guild.  However, necessity and the larege influx of permanent
residents have created a sort of housing development made up of tents
and shacks and other thrown together protection from the snow.  There
are campfires burning openly on the ground and people gathered around
doling out food.  Children run about, oblivious to the dark times.

name: Dirt Street Home
description:
This is one of the many "homes" on Dirt Street.  They are built from
tents and shacks, abandoned carts that have been overturned and
modified, furniture from the home they used to own, with cloth draped
over it to form a tent-like shelter.  None of them provides much in
the way of protection.

name: Town Hall
description:
The seat of the Arlysian Government resides here in the Town Hall.
However, most will tell you that the local Mayor is but a figurehead,
and that the real power in this city comes from the guilds and their
small offices, rather than this elaborate building.

name: Town Hall, Office of the Mayor
description:
This small office has been tastefully decorated, and primarily
consists of a large wooden desk and chair, and a handful of guest
chairs.  Plush cushions have been hand sewn to fit the seats of the
chairs.  Paperwork is neatly stacked on the desk, awaiting signatures.

name: Adventurer's Guild, Universal Trainer
description:
This large square room is completely empty, save for a large, exotic-
looking contraption placed right in the centre of the floor. It
appears to be made of a flat black metal, and is crafted in the shape
of a featureless humanoid. You recoginze it as a magical device used
to train people in their various abilities, and it uses its magical
powers to take any shape and to project illusions. This model looks
incredibly advanced, designed to train only the massively skilled.

name: Grand Hallway
description:
Flags of silk hang high above you in this massive hallway. The ceiling
easily reaches upwards of thirty feet, and the white stone gives the
passage an almost pristine quality. A carpet of royal purple has been
covers the floor in all directions, shimmering as if to honor your
prescence.

name: Shadowy Passage
description:
Pitchblack stones encase you in this passageway, giving you a feeling
of great unease. The rock seems to lash out at any form of light that
is found, and most chilling of all the passage is silent like that of
a coffin. Large black doors stand in your path, as if challenging you
to dare open them, unleashing whatever dark secret they hide.

name: Marble Room, Black Square
description:
Standing upon a large slab of colored marble, you find yourself in a
massive chamber. You see nothing of the ceiling above, save for a pale
light that shines from an unknown source. You notice the floor around
you is an alternating shade of white and black marble, each one a
different colour then the next. You vaguely see other shapes in the
darkness but can not make out what they appear.

name: Amber Fortress
description:
Light reflects brightly off the amber walls that make up this
fortress. A gentle and sure hand fashioned large blocks of amber to
fit in almost equal sections. The halls seem unusually quiet, except
for some whispering that can be heard. From the sounds of it someone
is in need of assistance.

name: Marble Room, Black Square
description:
Standing upon a large slab of colored marble, you find yourself in a
massive chamber. You see nothing of the ceiling above, save for a pale
light that shines from an unknown source. You notice the floor around
you is an alternating shade of white and black marble, each one a
different colour then the next. You vaguely see other shapes in the
darkness but can not make out what they appear.

name: Grand Chamber
description:
Flags of silk hang high above you in this massive chamber. The ceiling
easily reaches upwards of thirty feet, and the white stone gives the
passage an almost pristine quality. A carpet of royal purple has been
covers the floor, shimmering as if to honor your prescence.
A large glowing key floats in the center of the room, just out of
reach. On the far wall a wooden sign can be seen, a crude rusted nail
stabbed in the middle of it.
